parameters.content:
## HubSpot Deal → Slack War-Room Builder

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture (portal 99000001): zero network calls, zero Slack channels, zero CRM updates.

Go-live needs explicit opt-ins:
`SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `SLACK_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true` · `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true` (stamp = idempotency) · optional `AI_ENABLED=true`.

Secrets come only from `$env` in HTTP headers. Requires `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`. See README.md.

nodes.name: HubSpot Deal Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives HubSpot deal.propertyChange subscriptions or a HubSpot workflow "Send a webhook" action. Live mode requires header x-war-room-secret = WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, fail-safe flags, webhook secret check + header stripping.

nodes.name: Threshold & Idempotency Guard
nodes.notes: ARR >= threshold, currency, pipeline/stage, stamped channel, registry, in-flight lock.

nodes.name: HubSpot Context Collector
nodes.notes: Read-only batch reads (POST /crm/v3/objects/{type}/batch/read): company, contacts, calls, meetings, notes.

nodes.name: Executive Brief & Stakeholder Map Synthesizer
nodes.notes: Deterministic: firmographics, buying committee, coverage gaps, redacted activity digest, risks, next steps, channel slug.

nodes.name: AI: Synthesize Brief
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions. Failures fall back to the deterministic brief.

nodes.name: Slack: Create Channel
nodes.notes: No automatic retry: a retried create could produce a duplicate channel.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Stamp Deal War-Room
nodes.notes: Runs right after channel creation so the deal is marked before anything else can fail.

nodes.name: Slack: Post Executive Brief
nodes.notes: No automatic retry: a retried post could duplicate the brief.
